reviews.title: Gambling ads
reviews.text: You guys have gambling ads on an app that prohibits this…

reviews.title: Azaan Timing needs to fixed for
reviews.text: I’m resided in Abudhabi and this Ramadan it became a problem for me to keep the track of salah timings as the app shows way different timings than the actual. E.g ASR time is 3:50 today, the app is showing 4:47

reviews.title: Crashing
reviews.text: The app used to work fine, but it now crashes on launch after the recent update. Reinstalling and restarting didn’t help. Hopefully the developer releases a fix soon because the app is  now not useful.

reviews.title: Long adds
reviews.text: App it self is good effort to provide customers pryer times and many other features but when ever you will open the app it will show you longer adds. Which is very frustrating.
